buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer-Added Bid-Specific Conditions 1. Pre-Bid Meeting Attendance: All prospective bidders are required to attend the Pre-Bid Meeting scheduled for 07 November 2026. 2. Eligibility Based on Pre-Bid Attendance: Only bidders who attend the Pre-Bid Meeting shall be eligible to submit bids. Bidders who do not attend the Pre-Bid Meeting shall be automatically disqualified from the bidding process. 3. Pre-Bid Attendance Certificate: Each bidder must obtain a Pre-Bid Attendance Certificate from the organizing authority after the meeting. The certificate must be uploaded along with the bid documents as proof of attendance. 4. Minimum Turnover Requirement: The bidder must have achieved a minimum annual turnover of ₹3,00,000 (Rupees Three Lakhs Only) in any one of the last three financial years. Documentary evidence, such as audited financial statements or a certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant, must be submitted along with the bid. 5. Experience Criteria: The bidder must have a minimum of two (2) year of relevant experience in the field related to the scope of this tender. 6. Pre-Sample/Catalogue Submission: Before the bid submission deadline, bidders must submit a pre-sample and/or product catalogue of the offered product(s) for evaluation. The submitted sample(s) must comply with all specifications mentioned in the tender document. Failure to submit the required sample(s) or catalogue within the stipulated timeline shall result in rejection of the bid. The cost of sample preparation and delivery shall be borne entirely by the bidder, and the submitted sample(s)/catalogue shall not be returned. 7. Non-Blacklist Declaration: The bidder's firm must not be blacklisted or debarred by any Central Government, State Government, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), or any other Government authority/entity in India. A self-declaration to this effect, duly signed by the authorized signatory of the firm, must be submitted on ₹100 (Rupees One Hundred Only) Non-Judicial Stamp Paper, duly notarized by a Notary Public. 8. Self-Declaration for Timely Completion: The bidder shall submit a self-declaration confirming its ability to complete the work within the stipulated timeline. In the event of failure to complete the work within the specified period, a penalty of 1% of the total order value for every two (2) weeks of delay shall be

applicable, subject to the terms and conditions of the contract. 9. Warranty Declaration: The bidder shall submit a self-declaration along with a warranty certificate confirming thatthe supplied pro duct(s) shall carry a minimum warranty of one (1) year from the date of successful installation. 10. Toll-Free Service Support: The bidder shall provide a declaration confirming the availability of a toll-free customer support number for addressing product-related service and support requirements throughout the warranty period. 11. Installation and Training: The bidder shall be responsible for the installation, commissioning, and operational training of the supplied product(s) at the designated site. A self-declaration confirming compliance with this requirement must also be submitted. 12. ISO 9001 Certification: The bidder or the OEM of the offered product(s) must possess a valid ISO 9001 Quality Management System Certification. 13. Make in India (MII) Certificate: The bidder shall submit a valid Make in India (MII) Certificate/Declaration, wherever applicable, in accordance with the Government of India procurement guidelines. . 2. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
